title: comfy deploy models add / ls / rm --json data payload
description: `ls` carries `models`, every file added straight to the deployment, oldest first. `add` and `rm` carry `model`, the entry they made or are removing; `add` also says whether it sent bytes. An entry never carries comfy-deploy's failure text: a failed file reads `status: failed`, and the fix is to remove it, wait until `ls` no longer lists it, then add it again.

type.description: The model folder the file is in, such as loras.

status.description: adding until the deployment's workers can use the file, then ready, or failed; removing once a removal was asked.

uploaded.description: `add` only: false where the workspace already held these exact bytes, so none were sent.
